sections.title: Day 51 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
- 掌握採購單、裝箱單、發票比對與帳款爭議相關字彙
- 熟練 Should / Had / Were 倒裝條件與 Not until、Only when 倒裝
- 辨認 Listening 中說話者立場改變（原本打算 → 發現證據 → 改變決定）
- 整合 Triple Passage 中的採購單、發票與供應商回覆，找出證據衝突並計算應付金額
- 強化 Part 6 公告的目的句、被動語態與補充說明

建議訓練時間：**115 分鐘**。

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜Should / Had / Were 倒裝條件、Not until 與 Only when 倒裝、Under no circumstances、provided that / as long as
sections.markdown:
主題：**Should / Had / Were 倒裝條件、Not until 與 Only when 倒裝、Under no circumstances、provided that / as long as**

### 規則 1｜Should 倒裝條件

If + S + should 可省略 If 並把 should 移到句首，表示未來可能發生的情況。

> Should the invoice contain an error, please notify us within five days.

### 規則 2｜Had / Were 倒裝條件

Had + S + p.p. 表與過去事實相反；Were + S 表與現在事實相反。

> Had we checked the packing slip, we would not have overpaid.

### 規則 3｜Not until / Only when 倒裝

Not until 或 Only when 子句放句首時，主句用助動詞倒裝。

> Not until the audit began did the team notice the variance.

### 規則 4｜否定副詞片語倒裝

Under no circumstances / In no case 置於句首，主句倒裝。

> Under no circumstances should payment be released without a matching purchase order.

### 規則 5｜provided that / as long as 條件連接詞

provided (that)、as long as 引導條件子句，子句內用現在式表未來。

> We will accept the credit memo as long as it arrives before the ledger closes.

sections.title: 03 Listening｜Invoice Payment Reversal
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Woman: Kenji, the Corliss invoice is due Friday. I was planning to pay the full amount today so we avoid a late fee. Man: Before you do, look at the packing slip. It lists eight standing desks, but the invoice charges us for ten. Woman: Really? I assumed receiving had already checked it. Hmm, in that case, I'd rather not pay the whole thing. Let's pay the undisputed lines now and hold back the desk charge. Man: Good. I'll e-mail Corliss and ask for a revised invoice. Woman: And copy the audit team, please. They'll want a record of why we paid only part of it.

sections.title: 04 Listening｜Resolving a Pricing Error
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Man: Corliss billed the standing desks at four hundred forty-five dollars each. Our purchase order says four hundred twenty. Woman: They mentioned a new rate card that started on November first. Man: Right, but we ordered on October twenty-eighth, and their binding quote was valid until November fifteenth. Woman: Then the old price should apply. I'll call their account manager. If they agree, they can either send a revised invoice or issue a credit memo. Man: A credit memo is fine, as long as it arrives before we close the monthly ledger on the thirtieth. Woman: Understood. I'll make that a condition when I call.

sections.title: 05 Listening｜Accounts Payable Announcement
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Good morning, everyone. This is Priya from Accounts Payable. Starting December first, we will release payment only after three documents match: the purchase order, the packing slip, and the invoice. If any line item does not match, the invoice will be placed on hold and the requesting department will be notified within one business day. Please note that holds do not extend the vendor's payment terms, so departments should respond quickly. Invoices under two hundred dollars are exempt from the packing slip requirement. If you have questions, please contact our team rather than the vendor directly.

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜Vendor Invoice Dispute and Evidence Conflict
sections.markdown:
限時：**10 分 0 秒**。

### Purchase Order

> Purchase Order PO-7718 was issued by Northgate Dental Group to Corliss Supply on October 28. It lists 20 ergonomic chairs at $185 each, 10 standing desks at $420 each, and 20 monitor arms at $65 each, for a total of $9,200. Prices are based on Binding Quote Q-552, valid through November 15. Payment terms are net 30. Substitute products require the buyer's written approval.

用途：參考文件

### Vendor Invoice

> Corliss Supply Invoice INV-3390, dated November 10, bills Northgate Dental Group for 20 ergonomic chairs ($3,700), 10 standing desks at $445 each ($4,450), and 20 monitor arms ($1,300). Invoice total: $9,450. Note: Standing desk price reflects our updated rate card, effective November 1. A late fee of 2% applies to any balance unpaid after 30 days.

用途：參考文件

### Vendor E-mail Reply

> From: Dana Whitfield, Corliss Supply
> Date: November 12
>
> Thank you for flagging the desk charge. You are correct that Quote Q-552 was binding for orders placed before November 15, so the desk price should be $420. We will issue a credit memo for the difference. Our warehouse also confirms that only 8 desks were delivered; the remaining 2 are on backorder and will ship on November 20. We will bill those 2 desks when they ship. In the meantime, please pay the undisputed amount for the items you have received. No late fee will be charged on the disputed portion.

用途：參考文件

> Subject: New Invoice Matching Procedure
>

>

>

>

> 
> [4] _____

sections.title: ⑨ Day 51 小考
sections.markdown: 正式限時：**6 分 0 秒**。

sections.title: ⑩ 複習與錯題分類
sections.markdown:
回顧 **Day 48、Day 49、Day 50**。

### 複習重點
- Billed ≠ Delivered：發票數量要和裝箱單比對
- Rate card 與 binding quote 何者優先：看下單日與報價有效期
- Credit memo（抵減）≠ Refund（退款）
- Undisputed amount 先付，disputed portion 暫扣
- Listening 中 I was planning to... / I'd rather not... 代表立場改變

### 錯題標籤
- `G`：Grammar
- `INV`：Inversion
- `COND`：Conditional
- `SUBJ`：Subjunctive
- `L`：Listening
- `SHIFT`：Speaker Position Shift
- `DETAIL`：Key Detail
- `IMP`：Implication
- `I`：Information Integration
- `CALC`：Calculation
- `E`：Exception
- `U`：Updated Information
- `V`：Vocabulary

sections.title: ⑪ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
- 複習今日 30 個單字，選 8 個各造一個商務句子。
- Part 5 15 題首次限時 4 分鐘，第二輪 3 分 30 秒。
- Part 6 4 題重做，說明每題的上下文邏輯。
- Listening 三組各練兩次，第二輪使用 TTS 1.1x 且不看逐字稿，標出說話者改變立場的那一句。
- 重新整理 Northgate 帳單的證據鏈：purchase order → invoice → packing slip → vendor reply → 應付金額。
- Day 51 Quiz 第二輪限時 5 分 30 秒，記錄首次答案、耗時與 errorTags。

keyTakeaway: 掌握採購單、裝箱單與發票比對字彙；熟練 Should / Had / Were 倒裝條件與 Not until、Only when 倒裝；辨認 Listening 中說話者因新證據而改變立場。
